scope.runtime_mode: HAWKING_GLM_GPU_DEVICE_DSA=1, which already requires resident state and HAWKING_GLM_GPU_COMPACT_MLA=1

device_dispatches_when_all_three_project: gravity_rope_prefix_tail_f32 key assembly directly into the persistent index-key cache
gravity_rope_prefix_tail_f32 query assembly into lazy fixed scratch
closed_full_indexer_graph.key_flow: The affine-normalized wk output is consumed on device; its rotated prefix and unchanged tail are written directly at position*index_head_dim in the persistent cache.
closed_full_indexer_graph.query_flow: Every index head's rotated prefix and unchanged tail are assembled on device into non-aliasing lazy scratch and consumed by DSA scores.
closed_full_indexer_graph.rank_flow: Exact score-ordered u32 ranks remain on device and feed compact attention in the same command buffer.
closed_full_indexer_graph.diagnostic_readback: Only the final layer's rank is read after its attention command buffer completes; it is not an attention dependency.

kernel_contract.layout: For each head, convert an interleaved rotary prefix to concatenated halves and copy the remaining head-dimension tail unchanged.
kernel_contract.input_output_aliasing: Rejected before dispatch because concatenated writes can overwrite another thread's interleaved input.
kernel_contract.output_offset: Bounds-checked element offset supports direct writes into one position of the persistent index-key cache.
kernel_contract.geometry: Nonzero even rotary dimension no larger than index head dimension; lazy scratch construction fails closed before zero-byte Metal allocation.
kernel_contract.affine_layernorm: Existing gravity_layernorm_affine_f32 is alias-safe for this use because all input reductions complete before in-place output writes.

lazy_state.reuse: All buffers are reused across layers and tokens; affine parameters and one-position RoPE tables are overwritten only after the prior layer command buffer has completed.

synchronization_evidence.observed_rule: two host-visible dependency drains removed per full-indexer layer per token
synchronization_evidence.qualification: Exact live wait counts on the bounded complete-token fixture plus source-derived flagship arithmetic; not a sealed throughput measurement.

complete_token_numeric_parity_v2_1.fixture: deterministic one-layer, 16-vocabulary complete-token direct-u8 PQ fixture
